theorems.name: Erdos9796Mission.critical_cover_card_le_nine_of_tight_center
theorems.formal_statement:
theorem Erdos9796Mission.critical_cover_card_le_nine_of_tight_center
    (A : Finset Plane) (hconv : ConvexIndep (A : Set Plane))
    (hrich : HasNEquidistantProperty 4 A)
    (hcover : ∀ x ∈ A, ∃ p ∈ A.erase x, ∃ r : ℝ,
      0 < r ∧ dist p x = r ∧
      (A.filter (fun q => dist p q = r)).card = 4 ∧
      ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
        4 ≤ (A.filter (fun q => dist p q = s)).card → s = r)
    (p₀ : Plane) (hp₀ : p₀ ∈ A) (r₀ : ℝ) (h0 : 0 < r₀)
    (hexact : (A.filter (fun q => dist p₀ q = r₀)).card = 4)
    (huniq : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s →
      4 ≤ (A.filter (fun q => dist p₀ q = s)).card → s = r₀) :
    A.card ≤ 9 := by sorry
